rows.explainer:
In June 2025, after publishing this CEA, we discovered that we'd made an error when inputting the population of two cohorts in the spreadsheet where we derive this estimate. Due to the fact that this error had a marginal impact on cost-effectiveness and to preserve this CEA as a representation of our thinking at the time the grant was made, we have left this CEA as-is.

Correcting the error resulting in a -0.079% adjustment for self-report bias, which changes overall cost-effectiveness by <.1x

rows.label: input
rows.explainer: This estimate of GiveDirectly's value per dollar donated is out of date as of 2024. We are continuing to use this outdated estimate for now to preserve our ability to compare across programs, while we reevaluate the benchmark we want to use to measure and communicate cost-effectiveness.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar given to GiveDirectly
rows.explainer: GiveWell reports this model's result in multiples of cash transfers. Multiplying by GiveWell's value of a dollar to GiveDirectly converts it into units of value per dollar, so it ranks against the other models. Older sheets used older moral weights; the multiple of cash is the comparable number across years.
